inputs.name: ExposeParameters
inputs.description: Enable control from outside the graph asset

input.name: spawnRateMin
input.description: The minimum number of particles to spawn

input.name: spawnRateMax
input.description: The maximum number of particles to spawn

input.name: delayMin
input.description: The minimum duration of the delay this Block waits for before it spawns a burst of particles

input.name: delayMax
input.description: The maximum duration of the delay this Block waits for before it spawns a burst of particles

input.name: burstCount
input.description: The number of particles in each burst spawn

input.name: burstDelay
input.description: The duration of the delay this Block waits for before it spawns a burst of particles

description:
Spawns a number of particles in different modes. Constant: Add a spawn count over time at a constant rate. For instance, if the rate is 10, this Block triggers 10 spawn events per second for its Spawner Context. 
Periodic: Spawn a number of particles instantly periodically using a delay. 
Random: Spawns a random number of particles between two boundaries. The delay time is of a random duration between two boundaries.
